ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=4$, $BC=5$, $CA=6$, and the three angle bisectors intersect at point $O$. The area of $\triangle CAO$ equals $9$. What is the area of $\triangle ABO$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw $OM\perp AB$ at point M, and $OD\perp AC$ at point D, \\
since the three angle bisectors intersect at point O, \\
hence $OM=OD$, \\
since the area of $\triangle CAO$ is 9, \\
thus ${S}_{\triangle CAO}=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot OD=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\cdot OD=9$, \\
Solving this, we get $OD=3$, \\
thus $OM=3$, \\
therefore ${S}_{\triangle ABO}=\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot OM=\frac{1}{2}\times 4\times 3=\boxed{6}$.
